fts_rank.description: Present when result appeared in full-text search.

normalized_score.description: RRF score normalized to [0,1] for cross-method comparability

vec_distance.description: Raw cosine distance from vector search, null when not in vec results

vec_rank.description: Present when result appeared in vector search.

description: Response emitted by `sqlite-graphrag hybrid-search` on stdout as a single JSON line. backend_invoked and vec_degraded_reason added in v1.0.84 by ADR-0042.

truncated.description: GAP-SG-142: raised by the agent-native surface whenever it removed data from this envelope.

count.description: GAP-SG-142: emitted under --count-only, which replaces the payload. See agent-surface.schema.json#/$defs/CountOnlyEnvelope.

fts_auto_rebuilt.description: True when FTS5 was auto-rebuilt during this query

fts_degraded.description: True when FTS5 query failed and results are vector-only

fts_error.description: FTS5 error message when fts_degraded is true

max_graph_results.description: v1.2.2: ceiling applied to graph_matches. Active by default (50, overridable via --max-graph-results or XDG search.hybrid.max_graph_results); null when the cap is disabled with 0. Echoed so a truncated graph_matches is distinguishable from a small neighbourhood.

backend_invoked.description: v1.0.84 (ADR-0042): embedding backend that ran the live embedding for this query (openrouter or none). Omitted when embedding was skipped or the response fell back fully to FTS5.

vec_degraded_reason.description: GAP-SG-290 (v1.2.8): operator-facing PROSE for the degradation. NOT a closed set: what lands here is FallbackReason's Display, which embeds the provider's own message (e.g. "embedding failed: {msg}"), so any new provider error is a new string. The enum this field carried through v1.2.7 described the INTENT recorded in src/embedder/fallback.rs, never what the wire actually held. Match on vec_degraded_code instead.

vec_degraded_code.description: GAP-SG-290 (v1.2.8): stable, machine-readable code for the degradation, and the field a consumer should branch on. Seven values come from FallbackReason::reason_code(); fallback_fts_only marks the degradation the operator ASKED for via --fallback-fts-only. Absent when vec_degraded is false.

vec_degraded.description: GAP-SG-290 (v1.2.8): true when the live query embedding failed or was skipped and the handler ranked on FTS5 BM25 alone. Absent on the wire when false. Symmetric to fts_degraded.

vec_error.description: GAP-SG-290 (v1.2.8): human-readable description of the embedding failure that triggered the fallback. Same prose as vec_degraded_reason. Absent when vec_degraded is false.

warning.description: GAP-SG-290 (v1.2.8): advisory warning for callers that branch on top-level status, distinguishing an FTS5-only fallback from a clean hybrid response. Absent when not degraded.

title: HybridSearchResponse
